---
name: Improvement proposal
about: Suggest a focused improvement with a concrete use case
title: "[Idea] "
---

## Problem

What task is difficult today? Describe the user need before proposing an implementation.

## Proposed behavior

What should change? Include a small example using synthetic data.

## Alternatives

How do you handle this today, and why is it insufficient?

## Scope

Which commands or workflows would be affected? Leave out credentials, private recordings, personal calendars, and account configuration.
